warning_source: Ronen Bar — Director of the Shin Bet
recipient: Security Cabinet / political echelon, chaired by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu
warning_summary: Bar warned that severe prison overcrowding was already impairing the scale of IDF/Shin Bet arrests and that ending administrative release for security prisoners could make it harder to arrest Palestinians suspected of planning or carrying out terrorist attacks.
evidence_update: Two independent contemporaneous reports on 29 Aug (Israel Hayom and N12) place the warning in the Security Cabinet meeting held the previous week; contemporaneous coverage independently dates that meeting to 22 Aug. N12 on 30 Aug records a senior IPS official reinforcing the capacity concern. Official IPS Amendment 62 notice confirms the policy took effect 1 Sep. Published to Notion as WARN-123, Medium confidence.
gaps: No public cabinet minutes, recording or written Bar warning recovered. N12 on 1 Sep reported an IPS planning document disputing that the policy would dramatically worsen crowding in security wings; that contrary assessment is preserved.
